system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: redis-vpc
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    description: Dedicated VPC network for application caching and Redis access
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL
- name: redis-subnet-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    description: Subnet for application workloads accessing Memorystore Redis
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.redis-vpc.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
- name: app-cache-redis
  type: gcp-types/redis-v1:projects.locations.instances
  properties:
    parent: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1
    instanceId: app-cache-redis
    resource:
      displayName: app-cache-redis
      tier: BASIC
      memorySizeGb: 1
      authorizedNetwork: $(ref.redis-vpc.selfLink)
      connectMode: DIRECT_PEERING
      redisVersion: REDIS_7_0
      labels:
        environment: prod
        component: cache
        managed-by: deployment-manager
      redisConfigs:
        maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru
      maintenancePolicy:
        weeklyMaintenanceWindow:
        - day: SUNDAY
          startTime:
            hours: 3
            minutes: 0
            seconds: 0
            nanos: 0
outputs:
- name: redis-host
  value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.host)
- name: redis-port
  value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.port)
- name: redis-connection-string
  value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.host):$(ref.app-cache-redis.port)
- name: redis-network
  value: $(ref.redis-vpc.selfLink)
